common_gotchas: UDT Out DAT was removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later; avoid it for new networks.
Although it is an Out DAT, replies from destinations appear in the DAT contents.
Use udtoutDAT class methods or the send command to initiate output rather than expecting table input to auto-send.
Protocol choice must match the receiving UDT In DAT.
Windows firewall or OS network permissions can block UDT traffic.
build_relevance: legacy UDT networking; removed in TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later
key_concepts: UDT Out DAT is a legacy sender for UDT fast streaming or reliable messaging connections.
Official docs mark it removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later.
It can receive reply messages even though it is an Out DAT.
Use current TCP/IP, UDP, WebSocket, or WebRTC operators for new network designs unless maintaining old files.
notes: Official docs mark UDT Out DAT as removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later; keep it documented for legacy-file interpretation, not new-network planning.
